            AEMeasurable (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (Breakdown.stretchForm W v (Breakdown.gradField v) z.1 z.2))

                      Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.SmoothPieceEpsCore.restPart (m.epsP β).modes (m.epsP β).wt v

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds)
  (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P h w W w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
      Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
        (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
          (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
            (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
              ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                Breakdown.Coercive.IsSmoothPerturbation P v →
                  ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                    Breakdown.Coercive.ModeSquareSumHolds →
                      Breakdown.Coercive.ModeDerivativeHolds →
                        Breakdown.Coercive.ModeRotationHolds →
                          Breakdown.Coercive.SolenoidalModeHolds →
                            Breakdown.Coercive.SmoothPerturbationIsPerturbationHolds →
                              Breakdown.Coercive.WeightedSumSecondPartialsPairingHolds →
                                ∀ (Q : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                  Breakdown.Coercive.IsSolenoidalPartOf (Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v) Q →
                                    ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                          ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                              ENNReal.ofReal
                                                (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind
                                                    (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.muP β).modes ι) *
                                                  ((∑ α ∈ h.harmonics,
                                                          Breakdown.Coercive.gradAmp (Breakdown.gradField W) α σ y *
                                                            Breakdown.Coercive.velAmp v (ι - α) σ y) ^
                                                        2 /
                                                      (2 * (m.muP β).eta) +
                                                    1 / 2 * (m.muP β).eta * (m.muP β).wt y ^ 2 *
                                                      Breakdown.Coercive.velAmp v ι σ y ^ 2)) <
                                        ⊤ →
                                      (Breakdown.Coercive.muPairing
                                            (fun ι y => Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι * (m.muP β).wt y) v
                                            fun σ y =>
                                            Breakdown.Coercive.smoothRight P W v σ y - (fderiv ℝ (W σ) y) (v σ y)) -
                                          (∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                              ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                ∑' (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                  ENNReal.ofReal
                                                    (Breakdown.ModeWeights.ind
                                                        (Breakdown.PieceWeights.inPiece (m.muP β).modes ι) *
                                                      ((∑ α ∈ h.harmonics,
                                                              Breakdown.Coercive.gradAmp (Breakdown.gradField W) α σ y *
                                                                Breakdown.Coercive.velAmp v (ι - α) σ y) ^
                                                            2 /
                                                          (2 * (m.muP β).eta) +
                                                        1 / 2 * (m.muP β).eta * (m.muP β).wt y ^ 2 *
                                                          Breakdown.Coercive.velAmp v ι σ y ^ 2))).toReal ≤
                                        Breakdown.Coercive.muPairing
                                          (fun ι y => Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι * (m.muP β).wt y) v Q
